# Environment variables

<!-- Generated by internal/envdoc from the source; run make envdoc after changing a configuration struct. -->

Every configuration struct reads environment variables through `config.Load`. The names below are relative: the service chooses a prefix for each struct with an `envPrefix` tag, so `ENDPOINT` in `otlp.Config` is `OTLP_ENDPOINT` under `envPrefix:"OTLP_"`:

```go
type Config struct {
	OTLP  otlp.Config  `envPrefix:"OTLP_"`
	Kafka kafka.Config `envPrefix:"KAFKA_"`
}
```

Secrets (`config.Secret`) never appear in logs or in printed configuration. Packages that use the OpenTelemetry SDK also read the standard `OTEL_*` variables; see the README.

| Package | Struct |
|---|---|
| `auth/jwtauth` | [`jwtauth.Config`](#jwtauthconfig) |
| `datastore/postgres` | [`postgres.Config`](#postgresconfig) |
| `datastore/redis` | [`redis.Config`](#redisconfig) |
| `fx` | [`commonfx.AdminConfig`](#commonfxadminconfig) |
| `fx` | [`commonfx.GRPCClientConfig`](#commonfxgrpcclientconfig) |
| `fx` | [`commonfx.GRPCConfig`](#commonfxgrpcconfig) |
| `messaging/kafka` | [`kafka.Config`](#kafkaconfig) |
| `messaging/kafka/kafkaproto` | [`kafkaproto.Config`](#kafkaprotoconfig) |

## jwtauth.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/auth/jwtauth`: Config configures token verification.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ISSUER` | `string` | **required** | Issuer is the expected "iss" claim, such as https://keycloak.example.com/realms/main. |
| `AUDIENCE` | `[]string (separated by ",")` | **required** | Audience lists the accepted "aud" values (this API's identifiers); a token must name at least one. |
| `JWKS_URL` | `string` |  | JWKSURL is where the issuer publishes its keys. Empty discovers it from Issuer + /.well-known/openid-configuration. |
| `ALGORITHMS` | `[]string (separated by ",")` | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA` | Algorithms are the accepted signing algorithms. |
| `LEEWAY` | `time.Duration` | `30s` | Leeway tolerates this much clock skew in exp, nbf and iat. |
| `JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL` | `time.Duration` | `15m` | RefreshInterval is how often the keys are refreshed in the background. |
| `JWKS_MIN_REFRESH_INTERVAL` | `time.Duration` | `30s` | MinRefreshInterval is the least time between refreshes triggered by unknown key IDs. |

## postgres.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/datastore/postgres`: Config configures the pool.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HOST` | `string` | `localhost` | Host is the server host name or address. |
| `PORT` | `int` | `5432` | Port is the server port. |
| `DATABASE` | `string` | **required** | Database is the database to connect to. |
| `USER` | `string` |  | User is the role to log in as. With credential rotation (WithCredentials) the user and password come from the secret instead. |
| `PASSWORD` | `config.Secret` (secret) |  | Password is the role's password. |
| `SSLMODE` | `string` | `verify-full` | SSLMode is a libpq sslmode: disable, require, verify-ca or verify-full. The default, verify-full, checks the server certificate and host name; use disable only for local development. |
| `SSLROOTCERT` | `string` |  | SSLRootCert is a PEM file with the CA certificates that verify the server; empty uses the system roots. |
| `APPLICATION_NAME` | `string` |  | ApplicationName is reported to the server, in pg_stat_activity and server logs. |
| `MAX_CONNS` | `int32` | `10` | MaxConns is the pool size. Size it with the server's max_connections divided by the number of replicas. |
| `MIN_CONNS` | `int32` | `0` | MinConns keeps this many connections open while idle. |
| `MAX_CONN_LIFETIME` | `time.Duration` | `30m` | MaxConnLifetime closes connections older than this, so they are recycled regularly. |
| `MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME` | `time.Duration` | `5m` | MaxConnIdleTime closes connections idle for this long. |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_PERIOD` | `time.Duration` | `1m` | HealthCheckPeriod is how often idle connections are checked. |
| `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | ConnectTimeout bounds opening one connection, TLS and authentication included. |
| `STATEMENT_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` |  | StatementTimeout makes the server cancel statements running longer; 0 leaves the server default. |

## redis.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/datastore/redis`: Config configures the client.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ADDRS` | `[]string (separated by ",")` | `localhost:6379` | Addrs lists host:port addresses: one for a single node, several for a cluster or for Sentinel nodes (with MasterName). |
| `MASTER_NAME` | `string` |  | MasterName is the Sentinel master name; with it, Addrs lists Sentinel nodes. |
| `USERNAME` | `string` |  | Username and Password authenticate with Redis ACLs (or Password alone with requirepass). With credential rotation they come from the secret instead. |
| `PASSWORD` | `config.Secret` (secret) |  | Password is the ACL user's or requirepass password. |
| `DB` | `int` |  | DB is the logical database on a single node (not supported by clusters). |
| `TLS` | `bool` |  | TLS connects with TLS, verifying the server certificate. |
| `TLS_SERVER_NAME` | `string` |  | TLSServerName overrides the name checked in the server certificate. |
| `DIAL_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | DialTimeout bounds opening one connection. |
| `READ_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `3s` | ReadTimeout and WriteTimeout bound reading a reply and writing a command. |
| `WRITE_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `3s` | WriteTimeout bounds writing a command. |
| `POOL_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `4s` | PoolTimeout bounds waiting for a free connection when the pool is exhausted. |
| `POOL_SIZE` | `int` |  | 0: go-redis default, 10 per CPU |
| `MIN_IDLE_CONNS` | `int` |  | MinIdleConns keeps this many connections open while idle. |
| `CONN_MAX_LIFETIME` | `time.Duration` | `30m` | ConnMaxLifetime closes connections older than this, so they are recycled regularly. |
| `CONN_MAX_IDLE_TIME` | `time.Duration` | `5m` | ConnMaxIdleTime closes connections idle for this long. |
| `MAX_RETRIES` | `int` |  | MaxRetries retries commands after network errors. 0 disables retries; see the package documentation before enabling them. |

## kafka.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/messaging/kafka`: Config holds connection settings shared by producers and consumers.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BROKERS` | `[]string (separated by ",")` | **required** | Brokers are the seed brokers, host:port; the client discovers the rest of the cluster from them. |
| `CLIENT_ID` | `string` |  | ClientID identifies the client in broker logs and quotas; empty uses franz-go's default. |
| `TLS` | `bool` |  | TLS connects to the brokers with TLS, verifying their certificates. |
| `TLS_SERVER_NAME` | `string` |  | TLSServerName overrides the name checked in broker certificates. |
| `SASL_MECHANISM` | `string` |  | SASLMechanism is "", "plain", "scram-sha-256" or "scram-sha-512". |
| `SASL_USERNAME` | `string` |  | SASLUsername and SASLPassword authenticate with SASLMechanism. |
| `SASL_PASSWORD` | `config.Secret` (secret) |  | SASLPassword is the SASL password. |
| `DIAL_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `10s` | DialTimeout bounds opening one broker connection. |

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/messaging/kafka/kafkaproto`: Config configures the Schema Registry client.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |

## logging.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/observability/logging`: Config configures a logger.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEVEL` | `string` | `info` | Level is the minimum level: debug, info, warn or error, optionally with an offset such as "info+2". |
| `FORMAT` | `string` | `json` | Format is "json" (production) or "text" (local development). |
| `ADD_SOURCE` | `bool` |  | AddSource adds the source file and line of the log call. |
| `OUTPUT` | `string` | `stdout` | Output is where records go: "stdout" (the writer, by default standard output, for a log shipper or kubectl logs), "otlp" (the OpenTelemetry LoggerProvider given with WithLoggerProvider; see the logs package) or "both". |
| `TRACE_ID_KEY` | `string` | `trace_id` | TraceIDKey and SpanIDKey name the trace fields written to standard output. The defaults, trace_id and span_id, suit Grafana Loki and most pipelines; use trace.id and span.id for New Relic's and Elastic's logs-in-context. OTLP records carry the IDs natively instead. |
| `SPAN_ID_KEY` | `string` | `span_id` | TraceIDKey and SpanIDKey name the trace fields written to standard output. The defaults, trace_id and span_id, suit Grafana Loki and most pipelines; use trace.id and span.id for New Relic's and Elastic's logs-in-context. OTLP records carry the IDs natively instead. |
| `SERVICE` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version are added to every record. Empty fields are taken from the standard OpenTelemetry variables, as the tracing, metrics and logs packages do: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, and service.name, deployment.environment.name and service.version in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. So one pair of variables, set in the container or Pod spec, names the service in every signal. Values still empty are omitted. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version are added to every record. Empty fields are taken from the standard OpenTelemetry variables, as the tracing, metrics and logs packages do: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, and service.name, deployment.environment.name and service.version in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. So one pair of variables, set in the container or Pod spec, names the service in every signal. Values still empty are omitted. |
| `VERSION` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version are added to every record. Empty fields are taken from the standard OpenTelemetry variables, as the tracing, metrics and logs packages do: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, and service.name, deployment.environment.name and service.version in OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. So one pair of variables, set in the container or Pod spec, names the service in every signal. Values still empty are omitted. |

## metrics.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/observability/metrics`: Config configures metrics.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXPORTER` | `string` | `prometheus` | Exporter lists where metrics go, comma-separated: "prometheus" (scraped from Provider.Handler), "otlp", "otlp-grpc" or "otlp-http" (pushed every Interval), or "none". "prometheus,otlp" does both, for example while moving to a new backend. Empty means "prometheus". |
| `ENDPOINT` | `string` |  | Endpoint and Insecure override the shared otlp.Config for metrics. |
| `INSECURE` | `bool` |  | Endpoint and Insecure override the shared otlp.Config for metrics. |
| `EXPORT_INTERVAL` | `time.Duration` |  | Interval is the time between OTLP pushes. Zero means 60s. |
| `TEMPORALITY` | `string` |  | Temporality of pushed counters and histograms: "cumulative" (the default; what Prometheus-style backends such as Grafana Mimir expect) or "delta" (what New Relic and Datadog prefer). Up-down counters and gauges are always cumulative. Prometheus scraping is unaffected. |
| `CARDINALITY_LIMIT` | `int` |  | CardinalityLimit is the maximum number of series per instrument. Zero means 2000. It cannot be disabled. |
| `SERVICE` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service: in target_info for Prometheus, as resource attributes for OTLP. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service: in target_info for Prometheus, as resource attributes for OTLP. |
| `VERSION` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service: in target_info for Prometheus, as resource attributes for OTLP. |

## otlp.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/observability/otlp`: Config configures the OTLP connection.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROTOCOL` | `string` |  | Protocol is "grpc" or "http" (OTLP/HTTP with protobuf). Empty uses OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL if set ("grpc" or "http/protobuf"), else gRPC. |
| `ENDPOINT` | `string` |  | Endpoint is the backend address: host:port, or a URL such as https://otlp.nr-data.net:4318. With HTTP, the exporters append the signal path (/v1/traces, /v1/metrics, /v1/logs) to a URL without one. |
| `HEADERS` | `config.Secret` (secret) |  | Headers are sent with every export, as comma-separated key=value pairs with URL-encoded values, like OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS: "api-key=…" for New Relic, "Authorization=Basic%20…" for Grafana Cloud. It is a secret: it never appears in logs. |
| `INSECURE` | `bool` |  | Insecure disables TLS, for a collector on the same host or network. |
| `COMPRESSION` | `string` |  | Compression is "gzip" or "none". Empty uses the exporters' default. |
| `TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` |  | Timeout bounds each export. Zero uses the exporters' default (10s). |

## tracing.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/observability/tracing`: Config configures tracing.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EXPORTER` | `string` | `none` | Exporter is "none", "otlp" (protocol from the shared otlp.Config), "otlp-grpc" or "otlp-http". |
| `ENDPOINT` | `string` |  | Endpoint overrides the shared otlp.Config endpoint for traces, as host:port or a URL. Empty uses the shared endpoint, then the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* variables, then the exporter's default (localhost:4317 for gRPC, localhost:4318 for HTTP). |
| `INSECURE` | `bool` |  | Insecure disables TLS to the collector. |
| `SAMPLE_RATIO` | `float64` |  | SampleRatio, if set, samples this fraction (0 to 1) of new traces and follows the parent's decision for propagated traces. Nil uses OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER or, if unset, samples everything. |
| `SERVICE` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service in every span. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service in every span. |
| `VERSION` | `string` |  | Service, Environment and Version describe the service in every span. |

## vault.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/secret/vault`: Config configures the client.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ADDR` | `string` |  | Address is Vault's URL, such as https://vault.internal:8200. |
| `NAMESPACE` | `string` |  | Namespace is the Vault Enterprise namespace, if any. |
| `TOKEN` | `config.Secret` (secret) |  | Token authenticates when no auth method is given. |
| `CACERT` | `string` |  | CACert is a PEM file with the CA that signed Vault's certificate. |
| `TLS_SERVER_NAME` | `string` |  | TLSServerName overrides the name checked in Vault's certificate. |
| `TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `10s` | Timeout bounds each HTTP request to Vault. |
| `MAX_RETRIES` | `int` | `2` | MaxRetries is how often the Vault library retries 5xx and 412 responses, with its own backoff. The default is 2. |

## httpclient.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/transport/http/httpclient`: Config configures connection handling.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `30s` | Timeout bounds a whole call, including retries and reading the body. |
| `DIAL_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | DialTimeout bounds opening one TCP connection. |
| `KEEP_ALIVE` | `time.Duration` | `30s` | KeepAlive is the TCP keep-alive interval. |
| `TLS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | TLSHandshakeTimeout bounds the TLS handshake. |
| `RESPONSE_HEADER_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` |  | ResponseHeaderTimeout bounds waiting for response headers per attempt. Zero means no per-attempt limit beyond Timeout. |
| `IDLE_CONN_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `90s` | IdleConnTimeout closes idle connections after this long. |
| `MAX_IDLE_CONNS` | `int` | `100` | MaxIdleConns bounds idle connections across all hosts. |
| `MAX_IDLE_CONNS_PER_HOST` | `int` | `20` | MaxIdleConnsPerHost defaults to 20, not net/http's 2, which causes connection churn under load to a single host. |
| `MAX_CONNS_PER_HOST` | `int` |  | MaxConnsPerHost limits all connections to one host; 0 means no limit. |

## httpserver.Config

`github.com/Arif9878/common/go/transport/http/httpserver`: Config configures an *http.Server.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ADDR` | `string` | `:8080` | Addr is the listen address, host:port or :port. |
| `READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `5s` | ReadHeaderTimeout bounds reading request headers; it protects against slow-header (Slowloris) attacks. |
| `READ_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `30s` | ReadTimeout bounds reading the whole request, including the body. |
| `WRITE_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `35s` | WriteTimeout bounds the time from the end of the request headers to the end of the response. Set it to a negative value to disable it for streaming. |
| `IDLE_TIMEOUT` | `time.Duration` | `120s` | IdleTimeout bounds how long keep-alive connections wait for the next request. |
| `MAX_HEADER_BYTES` | `int` | `1048576` | MaxHeaderBytes bounds the size of request headers. |
